note: Cron jobs sleep in slices of at most 60 s and re-read the wall clock, so a suspend or forward clock step no longer delays a run by the remaining monotonic time; cron::shutdown_and_wait needs no Tokio time driver (returns at once when idle); a cron expression with no occurrence left now logs a warning. vespera_core: nullable enums list null, a nullable schema without type or $ref whose oneOf/allOf/not/anyOf rejects null serializes as anyOf [schema, null], Operation.callbacks is callback name -> runtime expression -> PathItem (new Callback alias), SchemaRef deserializes boolean schemas (true as {}, false as {"not":{}}), OpenApiVersion adds 3.0.4, 3.1.1 and 3.1.2. Multipart errors echo part names bounded to 64 chars with control characters escaped; the DefaultBodyLimit docs now match axum (the extractor applies it on every transport, 2 MB by default).
